memory.method: Seven one-second samples after ten-second warmup; sum of process working sets including webview children, shared pages may be counted more than once. Identical 36-title local fixture and local WebM; each app runs alone. This is a controlled workload, not a universal RAM guarantee.
memory.finalRepeat: The final binary run recorded idle values, then its test browser closed during playback. A new desktop test helper was rejected by automatic Computer Use approval.

limits: The exact Hope (2026) and Cyberpunk source encodes were unavailable; local media/provider fixtures tested codec and audio fallback.
Cloud HTTP and SQL tests used mocked authentication and local PostgreSQL, not the live user account.
Linux, Android, macOS and iOS need platform adapters and testing.
